question: Does reapplying the frozen 2.5 percent pivot chase boundary to the actual T+1 opening fill remove materially worse VCP entries?
development_scope: The full 2016-01-04 through 2026-06-30 interval is exposed frozen development data. Results select a research version and are not independent validation.

fixed_intervention.rule: Cancel a pending entry when the actual T+1 opening price exceeds the signal-date pivot by more than the detector's existing max_chase value of 2.5 percent.
fixed_intervention.causality: The pivot is frozen at the completed signal close and the opening price is known before an opening fill. No later bar or trade outcome is used.

next_if_pass: Register a separate VCP strategy version with the fixed actual-open chase cancellation and run one same-cost portfolio comparison over the three fixed eras and full interval.
next_if_fail: Stop actual-open chase handling without trying adjacent percentages. Continue strategy iteration at the next full trade-lifecycle mechanism.
stop_rule: Do not test another chase percentage or combine this rule with any other entry filter on this exposed interval.
